comparison.objective: Place a game piece to make a winning Connect Four move; unlike commissioning and locking a robot-axis damper through iterative impact testing.
comparison.physical_skill: Likely piece grasping and slot insertion, versus recessed hex-key engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, and torque-limited locking. Body and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies achieving a winning board state; no rubric, failure rules, or numeric thresholds are available. Candidate instead requires two safe, repeatable physical carriage stops within specified stroke, energy, velocity, rebound, drift, and locking constraints.
comparison.reason: The tested ability and outcome are game-state completion, not dynamic-response tuning and mechanical lock retention. Any shared grasp/insertion primitives are generic.
